overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that setting last_trade_session to a past session (10) and last_decision_on to a past date would prevent the stop order from being classified as a swing trade, but overlooked that the cooldown and minimum-size guards operate independently of the swing-trade classification logic.
why_it_breaks: The test sets last_trade_session to session 10 and last_decision_on to 2024-01-01, expecting the stop order to pass through without being blocked by cooldown or minimum-size rules. However, the stop order still executes and is classified as a swing trade because the cooldown guard only checks elapsed sessions since the last trade, and the minimum-size guard only checks notional against $50. The agent overlooked that the swing-trade count increments whenever a position exits regardless of cooldown/minimum flags, so three partial sells in one day breach the quarterly cap of 2.
